iterations: Initial feather/spike contact witnesses coincided with tube caps; independent serialized and posed checks rejected them. Interior overlap witnesses and two outer roots were corrected; controls01 and geometry01 preserve the failure.

Native01 review exposed inherited flared wrists, isolated rib plaques and an overly parallel feather crest on a bare scalp. Source controls02 preserve that geometry. Revised tapered wrists, curved rib arcs, pointed Maip skull ears and Uritu feather crown/nape/spread were independently rechecked and captured in native02.
reviewed: Native front/profile/rear, face/hair/crest/cloth/feathers/talons, extreme strides, attack, pain, intermediate death and lying poses; both presentation scenes per figure.
qualifications: Stylized closed component anatomy, projected painted faces, opaque hair/feathers and rigid fall/rest remain candidates. Fixed clothing and ornaments do not create modular inventory.

Broad art silhouettes can exceed provisional collision. No reference metric scale, cultural claims, powers, new taxonomy or campaign placement were adopted; existing combat/loot/identity/save fields remain authoritative.
